comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request, the exit code of a network error, the mock's answer to that request (by path), and a string the printed answer contains. The oparl CLI has no --base-url (its commands take whole URLs), so the command carries {base}: the mock's address, or offline https://mock:8080. The answer is the System of the ITK Rheinland OParl server (Düsseldorf), recorded on 2026-11-20.

/Oparl/system.name: Schnittstelle OParl 1.6
